perm.manage: Configure salary components and payroll rules
rules.accountant_notice: Tax and pension rates are configuration, not law. Have the school's accountant validate every rule set before you activate it.
error.staff_not_found: The staff member does not exist.
error.component_not_found: The salary component does not exist.
error.staff_component_not_found: That staff salary component does not exist.
error.rule_set_not_found: The payroll rule set does not exist.
error.rule_not_found: The payroll rule does not exist.
error.run_not_found: The payroll run does not exist.
error.component_code_taken: Another salary component already uses that code.
error.component_in_use: This component is still assigned to staff; deactivate it instead of deleting it.
error.component_amount_form: Set either a fixed amount or a rate, not both.
error.component_amount_negative: A salary component amount cannot be negative.
error.component_rate_range: A salary component rate must be between 0 and 100%.
error.component_overlap: This component already applies to the staff member in that period.
error.component_dates: The end date cannot be before the start date.
error.rule_set_dates: The effective end date cannot be before the start date.
error.rule_set_code_taken: Another payroll rule set already uses that code.
error.rule_set_frozen: A payroll rule set is frozen once it is activated; create a new version instead.
error.rule_set_not_draft: Only a draft rule set can be activated.
error.rule_set_empty: Add at least one active rule before using the set.
error.rule_set_not_active: Only an active rule set can be archived.
error.rule_set_active_delete: Archive the active rule set before deleting it.
error.rule_set_in_use: This rule set produced a payroll run and cannot be deleted.
error.rule_set_not_active_start: A payroll run must use an active rule set.
error.no_active_rule_set: Activate a payroll rule set before creating a run.
error.rule_key_taken: A rule with that key already exists in this set.
error.rule_invalid: This rule is not valid. Check the rates and make the brackets contiguous from zero.
error.run_exists: A payroll run already exists for that month.
error.run_finalized: A finalized payroll run cannot be recalculated.
error.run_not_calculated: Calculate the run before finalizing it.
error.run_empty: A run with no payslips cannot be finalized.
error.run_finalized_delete: A finalized payroll run cannot be deleted.
error.calculation_failed: Payroll could not be calculated. Check the rule set and the staff member's components.
